rationale: Record two tools-registry entries for build-speed measurement. The only changed lines that select this family are the two rows added to docs/status/tools.yaml (build-speed-scorecard and build-time-report), plus the CLAUDE.md digest regenerated from it. Both tools measure build and CI timing: one reads .ninja_log, -ftime-trace output and a dry run of a build manifest, the other records GitHub gate/queue timings into Shipyard metrics and reads each host's published vitals. Neither produces, renders, or packages a design artifact; the rest of the change is the host-vitals build snapshot, bench_diff's section mode, the governed-build metrics record, and their tests. The family is reached only because the registry manifest is a watched path.
